question.text: In the circuit shown, what will be the current through the $6 \mathrm{V}$ zener?

solution.text: According to the question Input voltage $V_{s}=10 \mathrm{V}$ Source resistance $R_{S}=1 \mathrm{k} \Omega$ Zener diode voltage $V_{Z}=6 \mathrm{V}$ $\because$ Breakdown voltage of zener diode is $=6 \mathrm{V},$ and the potential difference across the zener diode $5 \mathrm{V}$. $\therefore$ Current flow in zener diode $I_{z}=0$
